hints.title: Sliding Frequency Window Bounding
hints.text: Expand the right endpoint to include incoming characters while tracking distinct character counts.

hints.title: Left Boundary Shrinkage Condition
hints.text: Whenever the count of unique characters in the window exceeds k, advance the left boundary until distinct count returns to at most k.

hints.title: Dynamic Window Invariant Maintenance
hints.text: Maintain frequency dictionary of window characters. When size of dictionary exceeds k, decrement count at left pointer; if count hits zero, delete key and advance left. Update max length as right minus left plus one.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(K) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all substrings and counting distinct letters takes cubic O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding window advances each pointer at most N times, running in O(N) with O(K) frequency map storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle edge cases like k=0 or k greater than string length smoothly.
